QuestInfo.name: [Ribbon Pig] A Secret in the Ribbon
QuestInfo.0: You decided to hunt Ribbon Pigs and collect their ribbons. Talk to #b#p9000292##k to go to their habitat.
QuestInfo.1: Hunt Ribbon Pigs to collect 100 Red Ribbons and 100 Blue Ribbons.
QuestInfo.2: There was nothing strange about the ribbons. Talk to #b#p9000292##k for alternatives.

1.0: Good job! This should be more than enough to learn something from...
1.1: Hm... Turns out these are all ordinary ribbons. I don't even see any clues to where they're from. Completely unremarkable.
1.2: The ribbons themselves aren't peculiar, but I'll keep at it. Meanwhile we need to seek other measures. How about observing the pigs themselves? Let me find the optimal place for that. Talk to me later!

default.0: I don't think you've got enough ribbons. If you want to go back to where the Ribbon Pigs are gathered, #rforfeit the quest#k and talk to me.
